'''Nelson Flin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Flin was an active Alliance military operative. He was the best friend and blood-brother of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Evram Darkmere]], who passed information to the Alliance via Flin.
